selected_alpha_sufficiency.P_side: Let q|P and q|A. After common scaling take v,r,s q-units and k=v_q(u) with 0<=k<=m-1, m=v_q(P). Choosing k=0 makes U=A*u^2 have odd valuation 1 while V=B*v^2 is a unit. The two source roots are governed by AE characters chi(-kappa*B)=+1 and chi(rho*B)=+1. The two full-cover roots are governed by chi(kappa*B)=+1 and chi(rho*B)=+1 because the U-term leads Lminus/Lplus. CC gives chi(-1)=+1, so chi(-kappa*B)=chi(kappa*B); hence all four roots lift over Q_q.
selected_alpha_sufficiency.M_side: Symmetrically, for q|M and q|B choose v_q(v)=0 with u,r,s units. AE gives chi(kappa*A)=+1 and chi(rho*A)=+1, while the full-cover minus leading residue requires chi(-kappa*A)=+1. CC gives chi(-1)=+1, so the source and full-cover conditions agree.
selected_alpha_sufficiency.selected_alpha_q_congruent_1_mod8: Stage36-V supplies chi(2)=+1 and CC supplies chi(-1)=+1, so every selected alpha prime is q=1 mod8.

beta_hmu1_species.classification: hmu=1 at q|D0 occurs exactly for: odd m with q unused in C,D; even m with q|C; even m with q|D.
beta_hmu1_species.common_CC_row: chi(A*B,q)=+1, so A/B and A*B are Q_q-squares and source/extra radicands have the same squareclass whenever their Y-ratio is a q-adic square unit.

selected_C_even_m.setup: m even>=2 and q|C, so kappa has q-valuation 1 and rho is a unit.
selected_C_even_m.construction: Put y=(B/A)t^2 and choose y=1+q*c with c a q-unit. Since 1<m, both minus factors 1-y and 1-lambda^2*y have valuation 1 with the same normalized unit; choose c for the kappa*A character. The plus factors are q-units. AE's q|C row chi(2^(1-f)*A*D)=+1 is exactly the character of 2*rho*A up to a square factor, so both plus roots exist.

selected_D_even_m.setup: m even>=2 and q|D, so rho has q-valuation 1 and kappa is a unit.
selected_D_even_m.construction: CC chi(AB)=+1 together with AE chi(-AB)=+1 forces chi(-1)=+1, so y=-1 is an accessible square residue. Choose y=-1+q*c. Since 1<m, both plus factors have valuation 1 and the same normalized unit; choose c for rho*A. The minus factors are units, and AE's q|D row chi(eta*2^(1-e)*A*C)=+1 is exactly the character of 2*kappa*A up to a square factor.

unused_odd_m_beta.setup: m=v_q(D0) odd and q unused in C,D. Put y=(B/A)t^2, which is a q-adic square because chi(AB)=+1. Let k=chi(kappa*A), r=chi(rho*A), epsilon=chi(-1), s=chi(2).
unused_odd_m_beta.generic_unit_sector: v_q(y)=0, y mod q not +/-1: realizable iff there is a nonzero square y in F_q, y!=+/-1, with chi(1-y)=k and chi(1+y)=r.
unused_odd_m_beta.near_plus_one: If m>=3, choose even 2<=n<m in y=1+q^n*c. Then source/extra minus roots have the same even valuation and plus roots are units; this sector is realizable iff s*r=+1.
unused_odd_m_beta.near_minus_one: If m>=3 and epsilon=+1, choose even 2<=n<m in y=-1+q^n*c. This sector is realizable iff s*k=+1.
unused_odd_m_beta.m_equal_1: near +/-1 cannot contribute because the affected source root has odd valuation; the small/generic/large sectors are exhaustive.
unused_odd_m_beta.criterion: the disjunction of the five stated sectors is necessary and sufficient for unused odd-m beta hmu=1 local realization.
